_comment: The real T0/T1 setup as built on Oct 18 (docs/experiments/E00-measurement-check/README.md, 'Setup as built'). Use: python tools/sim/simulate.py --config tools/sim/configs/real_oct18.json --out <dir>. Only the settings listed here differ from the defaults (simulate.py --write-config shows them all). Not modelled: the black-and-white picture (the simulator has no grayscale setting; the real camera has saturation 0).

camera._comment: Overhead USB camera: about 262 cm (103 in) above the board, looking straight down, 640 x 480 at 25 fps, about 3.4 px per cm (640 px / 3.4 = 188 cm of floor across the picture). Floor origin (0, 0) at the bottom-right of the picture, x up the picture, y to the left: yaw -90. Lens point straight down over the board's middle (not measured: no plumb line), level, no lens term (the calibration fits one if needed). No boxes: the simulator puts them at y 62-68 cm, which is on this board.

session._comment: The board is 122 x 122 cm (48 x 48 in) plywood with no tape axes: its edges are drawn as the 'tape lines'. The simulator starts every route from one pose; (20, 40) facing +x keeps the straight 100 cm run, the 50 cm square and the L on the board and in view (the real sheet uses a separate start spot per route).
